raw.description:
Overview:

SOFTSWISS is hiring a Senior Copywriter to join our PR Team. You’ll create PR and social media content that communicates our products, expertise and company news to external audiences across media, industry platforms and corporate channels.

Purpose of the Role:

Own the quality and delivery of written communications across PR and social media, turning business, product and brand inputs into clear, accurate and engaging external content. You’ll work closely with the PR and SMM teams while operating independently: understanding the objective behind each task, identifying missing information, working directly with relevant stakeholders, and bringing content to a publication-ready standard.

Key Responsibilities:

PR

  • Write and edit press releases, media announcements and other PR materials that clearly communicate company news and key messages.

  • Create thought-leadership articles, expert comments, interview materials and LinkedIn Pulse articles for company and external platforms.

  • Own the awards submission process, from maintaining the awards calendar and identifying opportunities to preparing submissions and coordinating stakeholder input.

  • Manage and update company profiles across relevant media platforms and industry directories.

  • Prepare executive presentations, talking points and supporting marketing materials in collaboration with internal experts.

  • Conduct independent research and fact-checking to ensure content is accurate, relevant and well-supported.

Social Media

  • Produce approximately 4–5 social media posts per week across agreed corporate channels.

  • Turn complex product, business and expert topics into clear, engaging and accessible social content.

  • Research topics, analyse data and collaborate with internal experts to uncover useful insights and stories.

  • Turn large volumes of information into concise, structured and engaging digests.

  • Adapt product updates, interviews, expert quotes and public-speaking materials into social-first formats.

  • Monitor events, awards, company news and media coverage to create timely digests with relevant context and analysis.

  • Support special social media projects with copy, messaging and editorial input.

Editorial Quality & Ownership

  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned content, from clarifying the brief and gathering input to fact-checking and delivering publication-ready copy.

  • Apply strong editorial judgement to identify weak messaging, factual gaps and unsupported claims before final review.

  • Maintain consistency in messaging, terminology and tone of voice across external communications.

  • Work autonomously from idea development and research through final copy and delivery.

  • Create editorial content around defined topics and priorities, including content designed to improve visibility in search and LLM-driven discovery.

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in copywriting, journalism, PR writing or editorial work.

  • Excellent written English, ideally at C1+ or near-native level.

  • Russian at C1+ level.

  • Strong writing and editing skills across multiple content formats.

  • Strong research and fact-checking skills.

  • Experience working independently with internal experts and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong editorial judgement and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple content streams and deadlines simultaneously.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in B2B technology, iGaming or another complex industry.

  • Professional experience covering both PR and social media content.

  • Good understanding of social media formats, post structure and platform mechanics.

Our Benefits:

  • Private health insurance

  • Sports benefits

  • Comprehensive Mental Health Program

  • Free English lessons (online)

  • Local language courses

  • Paid time off

  • Maternity leave support

  • Referral program rewards

  • Upskilling, internal workshops, and participation in professional conferences and corporate events

raw.description:
Shape what’s next in dental technology.
Join Henry Schein One!

Join a global leader redefining dental practice management and do work that actually matters. At Henry Schein One, we are a team of care catalysts: people who fuel innovation, challenge the status quo, and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to everything we do. Your ideas fuel innovation that enhances patient care and drives real results for practices. 

We don’t just talk about impact; we build it! Backed by a trusted reputation, our leaders foster an inclusive and supportive environment where we stay solely focused on our mission, empowering you to think boldly, collaborate creatively, and grow. We have high expectations for performance and delivering results; as part of a winning team, you’ll work hard, challenge the status quo, and bring a growth mindset. Here, your strengths are recognized, your development matters, and your wins celebrated. 

As a Telecom Engineer you help power the communication platforms that keep our business connected. You'll provide frontline support for NICE CXone, RingCentral, and next-generation cloud voice solutions, resolving technical issues, maintaining telecom workflows, and assisting with call flow design and implementation. Working closely with senior engineers and business stakeholders, you'll contribute to system enhancements, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while developing expertise in modern cloud contact center and telecom technologies and making a direct impact on both employee and customer experiences through reliable, innovative communication solutions.

This position is remote within the United States with up to 10% travel as needed.

What You Will Do
  • Provide Tier 1 support for RingCentral and NICE CXone environments, resolving issues related to user access, call quality, device configuration, routing errors, IVR functionality, and other telecom-related incidents
  • Provision and manage user accounts, roles, and system configurations while monitoring platform health, system alerts, queue performance, and routing behavior
  • Perform initial incident triage and troubleshooting using telecom diagnostic tools and dashboards, documenting findings and escalating complex issues to Tier 2/3 engineering teams with complete case details
  • Assist with the development, modification, testing, validation, and documentation of call flows within NICE CXone Studio and RingCentral administration platforms
  • Maintain accurate change records, version control, support documentation, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base content to support ongoing operational excellence
  • Partner with senior telecom engineers during system implementations, major deployments, and high-volume support periods to ensure service stability and performance
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, align telecom configurations with business needs, and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical users
What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of experience in IT or telecom support roles
  • Hands-on experience with NICE CXone and RingCentral platforms
  • Familiarity with IVRs, call routing, user provisioning, and basic telecom workflows
  • Exposure to scripting or workflow tools (CXone Studio preferred
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while maintaining high levels of service and support
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability by driving issues through resolution and following up with vendors and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills and attention to detail
What Will Set You Apart
  • Associate’s Degree in Information Technology or a related field
  • Training or certifications on RingCentral or NICE CXOne
  • Basic scripting knowledge (e.g., XML, JavaScript, Snippet)
  • Proficient in SIP ladder analysis and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting and administering Amazon Connect and Salesforce Service Cloud Voice environments, including call routing, contact flows, user configuration, softphone troubleshooting, unified CRM-telephony operations, and cross-platform issue resolution
  • Knowledge of Salesforce Omni-Channel Routing, Voice Call Objects, CTI integrations, and Agentforce Voice capabilities, including AI-powered voice automation that enhances contact center operations, real-time customer interactions, and agent productivity

The posted range for this position is $73,000 - $95,000, which is the expected starting salary range for an employee who is new to the role to fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including prior experience, current skills, location/labor market, internal equity, etc.This position is eligible for a bonus target not reflected in the range.

What You’ll Gain as a #TeamSchein Member

A robust benefits package including health coverage, retirement savings with company match, paid time off, parental leave, wellbeing resources, education support, and MORE!

Henry Schein, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability that can be reasonably accommodated without undue hardship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, citizenship, marital or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Job Summary

Full-time and part-time travel consultant openings to fill evening and weekend hours. This role will provide quality customer service to Acendas Travel's corporate clients who travel domestically and/or internationally, while accurately managing all travel requests, following the appropriate process and procedures. This individual must be a self-directed and technology-driven team player. Full-time roles include evening hours plus a weekend day with a 4-day 10-hour schedule. Part-time hours could include days, evenings or weekend hours.

  • A high volume of monthly transactions is required.
  • Utilize Global Distribution Systems (GDS) queues, scripts, and programmable keys to successfully fulfill travel requests.
  • Queue management and project work.
  • Act as the advocate for the client to ensure travel needs are met and customer satisfaction exceeds expectations while following travel policy.
  • Email monitoring and response.
  • Special Projects as assigned.

Transferable Skills

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
  • Possess a passion for serving customers with proactive solutions.
  • Effective strong consultative selling skills and the ability to listen to the customers’ needs; in turn, offering confident recommendations, resulting in high customer satisfaction with the service they receive.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks in high-pressure situations while developing a rapport with the customer.
  • Excellent critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of corporate travel technology products.
  • Ability to work independently and within a team, developing strategies and action plans and implementing goals and objectives.
  • Ability to respond to change.
  • Ability to embrace diversity.
  • Professional manner and appearance.
  • Effective organizational and time management skills.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of four (4) years’ corporate travel experience is required.
  • Knowledge of travel agency operations is required.
  • Ability to work shifts to cover extended hours.
  • Advanced knowledge of Sabre reservation system is required.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously.

Open shifts include:
Full-time four (4) days at ten (10) hours per day with either a Saturday or Sunday
Part-time shifts are up to twenty (20) hours per week, weekday evening hours or weekend shifts

Dealer.com is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Digital Marketing & Advertising Strategist to join our Dealer Marketing Operations team. This remote role is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing and communications strategies across paid search engine marketing, paid social media, and various other advertising platforms. You will manage a portfolio of dealer accounts, ensuring high performance, client satisfaction, and retention through data-driven advertising and tailored content strategies.

Note: This is notan SEO or organic social content role, though that experience might be beneficial.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Marketing & Communications

  • Develop and execute paid digital marketing initiatives including Google and Microsoft search, various social media platforms, and display/video strategies for assigned products or product areas.
  • Tailor advertising content to specific platforms and target audiences to maximize engagement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Analytics, Innovation, and Advertising Operations to ensure seamless execution and performance tracking.

  • Track all client interactions, optimizations, and decisions to maintain a clear audit trail and documentation in Salesforce.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and less than 2 years of experience, or 4 years of experience with no degree.

  • Google Search, Display and Shopping + Microsoft Ads certifications preferred but must be obtained within 90 days of hire. (If you possess these certs, please be sure to include them on your resume.)
  • Excellent communication, time management, email management, and client relationship skills.

Drug Testing

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

People come to TopDog Law at one of the hardest moments of their lives: injured, overwhelmed, and unsure of what comes next. They need someone in their corner who knows their name, understands their situation, and is actively fighting to get them the best possible outcome. The Case Manager exists to be that person, a dedicated advocate who owns the client relationship completely and ensures no one ever feels like just a file number. When this role is done right, clients feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is genuinely working for them.

What You Will Own

  • Own the client relationship from day one through settlement, the Welcome Call is yours, the relationship is yours, and the outcome is yours
  • Be the client's dedicated advocate, connecting them to the right care fast and walking them through one of the most stressful experiences of their life with confidence and compassion
  • Drive cases forward with urgency, moving through each phase with precision and purpose
  • Build demand packages that tell a compelling story and negotiate toward outcomes that make a real difference for real people
  • Be the source of truth on every case you touch, leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay sharp, move fast, and never let anything slip
  • This is not a hand-off role, it's full ownership, and for the right person, it's one of the most impactful seats in the firm

What You Bring

Required:

  • 2–6 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in Arkansas
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor's degree or Paralegal Certificate
  • Experience in a high-volume or fast-growing law firm
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: [Min} and [Max], commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

Who we are:

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. We equip universities and healthcare providers with the infrastructure needed to expand clinical education across all healthcare disciplines. With partnerships spanning 100+ allopathic (MD), osteopathic (DO), nursing (NP and pre-licensure), PA, and allied health degree programs at 650+ healthcare institutions nationwide and internationally, AMO is solving the healthcare training shortage by enabling quality clinical education at scale.

Since expanding to domestic B2B solutions in 2020, we've secured 75+ partnerships with U.S. academic institutions and placed students in nearly 6,000 clinical rotations. Our proprietary SaaS platform and comprehensive service solutions help schools expand enrollment, open new clinical campuses, and prepare for accreditation visits.

At AMOpportunities, we're guided by a clear set of values that shape how we show up for each other and for those we serve, every day.

  • Trust: Trust the process. Trust one another.
  • Impact: Local focus, global impact. Solutions today for tomorrow.
  • Be a global citizen: Collaborative mindset. Embrace our differences. Work better together.
  • Quality: High quality service. Delighting those we serve.
  • Adapt with Agility: Embrace change. Move fast, stay flexible.
  • Rooted in Relationships: Strong partnerships. Support and celebrate each other. Grow together.

Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. AMOpportunities encourages you to apply even if you do not meet all listed qualifications. We look forward to your application. 

About the position:

The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator is responsible for building and expanding AMO's national clinical network by identifying, engaging, and developing partnerships with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and healthcare organizations that support clinical education programs.

This is a highly results-driven role designed for professionals who already possess a strong foundation in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, or credentialing and are motivated to make an immediate impact. While AMO provides training on our systems, processes, and platform, successful candidates bring industry knowledge, professional judgment, and the confidence to quickly operate with a high level of independence. This role is remote, but theMedical Education – Network Development Coordinator is expected to collaborate with teammatesvirtually ona regular basis to ensure team goals are met and recruited leads successfully transition into active clinical training sites and preceptor partnerships. The company alsomaintainsan office in Chicago that theCoordinator mayutilizeon an as-needed basis.

The Medical Education – Network Development Coordinator owns a strategic recruitment pipeline from initial outreach through onboarding readiness, balancing relationship-building with measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is driven by thoughtful execution—not simply outreach volume. High performers know how to prioritize opportunities, build trusted relationships, and consistently convert conversations into long-term clinical partnerships that support AMO's continued growth.

This position is best suited for professionals who thrive in an environment built on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, thinking strategically, and delivering measurable results will excel in this role.

 

While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, or Texas.

Essential Functions:

  • Build and expand AMO's clinical network by identifying, engaging, and recruiting physicians, PAs, NPs, and clinical training sites through strategic outreach utilizing email, phone, video, social media, and other communication channels
  • Own a high-volume recruitment pipeline from prospecting through onboarding readiness, prioritizing opportunities effectively while consistently meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly performance expectations
  • Leverage HubSpot and other tech tools to build, prioritize, and manage a strategic outreach pipeline while maintaining accurate documentation, reporting pipeline health, and using data to drive recruitment strategy
  • Apply working knowledge of provider types (MD, DO, PA, NP), clinical specialties, and credentialing requirements—including licensure, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related verification processes—to efficiently qualify prospective partners
  • Educate physicians, advanced practice providers, and healthcare organizations on the value of partnering with AMO to support the next generation of healthcare professionals
  • Guide prospective partners from initial outreach through onboarding readiness while following documented SOPs, maintaining exceptional attention to detail, and exercising sound judgment to resolve issues independently
  • Negotiate educational stipends, collect required contractual and credentialing documentation, and ensure complete, accurate handoffs to internal teams
  • Collaborate closely with Partnerships, Operations, and cross-functional teams to meet school partner needs and placement timelines
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with both external partners and internal stakeholders, leveraging professional networks such as LinkedIn, while ensuring timely follow-up and exceptional customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment strategies, outreach effectiveness, and internal processes while maintaining consistency with established workflows
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills, Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, credentialing, or a related healthcare field strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding either KPIs, quotas, or performance metrics in a goal-oriented environment, or deadlines in a clinical education environment
  • Experience working with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and/or healthcare organizations preferred
  • Strong understanding of provider credentialing processes, including licensure verification, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related healthcare documentation
  • Experience managing CRM-based recruitment or business development pipelines; HubSpot experience strongly preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence healthcare professionals, navigate objections, and build long-term professional relationships. Comfortable with utilizing professional networks and social presence (LinkedIn) to generate opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and consistently execute documented processes while exercising sound judgment and independent decision-making
  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives, adapt to changing placement needs, and maintain urgency without sacrificing accuracy
  • High level of professionalism, accountability, and ownership with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where individual performance directly contributes to team success

What You Gain:

  • Competitive base salary of $65,000 to $75,000 annually, and bonus structure tied to the achievement of KPIs and revenue goals.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Program: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Tax Exempt Student Loan Repayment, and Commuter Benefits
  • A mission-driven work environment committed to a spirit of support, growth, and achievement
  • Performance-based career growth opportunities
  • A front-row seat for the exponential growth of a booming education tech company
  • Work/life balance

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are deeply committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, and to providing our employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment based on disability, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy status (including childbirth and related states), sexual orientation, race, color, social or ethnic origin, religion, age, HIV status, past/present military service, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a hands-on AWS threat hunter with strong technical and analytical skills, genuine curiosity about cloud attack techniques, experience hunting for evidence of adversarial activity, and the ability to develop defensive capabilities to counter them. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of hands-on threat hunting experience in cloud environments, preferably AWS.

You will work with complex, high-profile organizations across the globe, conducting threat hunting in cloud environments to identify active and historical threats, reviewing cloud control plane configurations, and providing technical recommendations to reduce adversary opportunity in target environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Utilize the Falcon platform and threat intelligence to analyze cloud logs and identify historical and active threats.

  • Baseline and review cloud security configurations, looking for anomalies associated with threat activity.

  • Develop queries and scripts to work with large volumes of data, including correlating data across multiple sources and identifying outliers that may be indicative of threat activity.

  • Identify identity and control plane configurations that may expose cloud environments to threats and unauthorized access.

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of client projects, including project management, communication, status updates, and task assignment.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings for key stakeholders, including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel.

What You’ll Need:

Technical Skills:

  • An in-depth understanding of cloud adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), including attack path chaining and enriching data with threat intelligence.

  • An in-depth understanding of the AWS platform, including the following domains: logging, identity, networking, workload security, data security, and multi-account management practices.

  • A solid grasp of AWS security architecture patterns, including log management architecture and automation patterns leveraging AWS-native services.

  • A strong knowledge of security configuration and architecture of CI/CD pipelines

  • A strong ability to write modular scripts and software tools in Python or Go to work with AWS services and Falcon APs.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Communication Skills:

  • A strong ability to verbally communicate technical concepts and findings in plain English to technical and non-technical audiences, including CISO-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent technical writing skills and ability to produce high-quality written reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and CrowdStrike clients.

  • Attention to details, time management, delegation. This is a consulting role and excellent organizational skills are non-negotiable.

We care about what you know and what you can do, not the specific path you took to get here. Strong candidates will have built real depth in cloud platforms and security over time - whether through years in dedicated security roles, a background in cloud engineering or DevOps that shifted toward threat hunting, or any other route that got them to the same place. What matters is that the knowledge is solid and the skills are demonstrable.

This role may require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass alcohol and/or drug test(s) during the course of employment.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at further assistance.

The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 2 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
    • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process

  • Screening Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • 1st Stage - Video interview with Team Lead (45 mins)
  • Final Stage + Presentation - Video interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins)
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

Requirements:

  • Prior experience in email/chat-based customer support (experience in e-commerce or online retail is a strong advantage).

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. raw.title: Chief Technology Officer - Remote (Americas time zones)
raw.excerpt: This is a remote position. Why this role existsSell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions.
raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Why this role exists

Sell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions. We help homeowners unlock their home equity without moving, while connecting properties with single-family rental investors. We operate in 30+ states and have closed 200+ transactions.

Technology is a key driver of our growth. We’ve built a proprietary operating platform, AI agents for lead qualification and outreach, an investor-matching layer, and a lead engine that supports our sales process.

We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who sees technology as a growth and revenue engine — not just an engineering function. You’ll work closely with Sales, and Marketing, to use AI, automation, data, and product to generate more qualified leads, improve conversion, accelerate the sales cycle, and close more transactions.

You’ll inherit real, revenue-generating technology, a talented team, and the opportunity to create the technology strategy that will help Sell2Rent scale faster and sell more.

If you’re excited about using technology to drive measurable business results, this is your opportunity to make a major impact.

What you'll own

Technology strategy.You set the direction: architecture, build-vs-buy, which platforms we standardize on, where AI is a genuine advantage and where it's a distraction. You'll be the person in the room who knows what's actually possible and what it costs.

The engineering organization.You lead a distributed team of roughly ten across engineering and data, all of them in Latin America. You'll grow it, structure it, and set the bar.

Scaling the platform.Our twelve-month mandate is to ship the roadmap and scale what we've built — completing the migration off legacy systems, hardening the platform, and getting to a place where the business can grow transaction volume without engineering becoming the bottleneck.

The AI layer.Agents handle a meaningful share of our qualification, outreach, and internal operations today. Deciding how far that goes — and building it so it's a durable advantage rather than a demo — is one of the most interesting problems here.

Resilience and continuity.Security, access governance, vendor management, monitoring, documentation, and the discipline that ensures no single person is ever again the only one who knows how something works. We've learned this lesson the expensive way and we're not repeating it.

Executive partnership.You sit on the Executive Committee. You'll work directly with the CEO and the sales, marketing, and operations leaders — translating what the business needs into what gets built, and telling us honestly when what we're asking for is a bad idea.


Requirements

Who we're looking for

  • 15+ years in technology, with progressive leadership responsibility and time as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Technology.

  • You've scaled a team and a system before.Not just managed one — took something from working-but-fragile to reliable-at-volume, and grew the org that did it.

  • You are technical enough to be trusted, but your job is not to write the code.You should be able to read our architecture, challenge a design decision, and evaluate a vendor on the merits. We have engineers to build. We need someone who can direct them and know when the answer is wrong.

  • Real depth in AI-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure (we run on GCP), APIs, integrations, and data. Depth, not enthusiasm — you can tell us what LLM-based agents actually break on in production.

  • You find blind spots.Much of the value in your first six months is telling us what we don't know we're missing — in our architecture, our tooling, our security posture, and our process.

  • You lead people well.Our team is remote, distributed, and international. Keeping engineers motivated, growing, and clear on what matters is a large part of this job.

  • Startup-fluent.You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and making decisions before all the information arrives.

  • Business-minded.You can connect a technical investment to revenue and defend it to a CEO who will ask.

Helpful, not required:real estate, proptech, or fintech experience; running a US-based company with a LatAm engineering team; Spanish.

How this role fits with product

Our CEO owns product direction and will continue to for the foreseeable future, working closely with the commercial leadership team. You own technology, architecture, and execution. You'll have real influence on what we build and strong input on sequencing — but the product roadmap is not yours to set, and we're not planning to hand it over.

We're stating this plainly because the previous version of this role blended both, and the wrong expectation here makes an otherwise great partnership fail. If owning a product is what you're looking for in your next role, this isn't it.

What success looks like

By 90 days— you know where every system, credential, vendor, and dependency lives, and so does someone besides you. You've told us the three things about our architecture that worry you most. The team knows who they report to, what they're building, and why it matters.

By 6 months— the platform migration is on a credible path, engineering has a real operating cadence, and technology decisions are being made deliberately rather than reactively. You've made at least one hire that raises the bar.

By 12 months— we've shipped the roadmap, the platform handles significantly more volume without more people, and our AI capability is a genuine competitive advantage rather than a set of internal tools. Nothing critical depends on any single individual, including you.


Benefits

Details

  • Location:Remote, with meaningful overlap with US Eastern and Latin America.

  • Compensation:Competitive base plus meaningful equity. We'll be direct about the range early in the process.

  • Team:~10 in technology and data; company-wide, a lean and fast-moving organization.

Our process

  1. Intro call with the CEO — 45 minutes, mutual fit.

  2. Technical and architectural conversation — we'll walk you through what we've actually built and get your honest read on it.

  3. Meet the engineering team and two executive peers.

  4. A working session on a real problem we're facing. Paid, if it requires meaningful preparation.

  5. References and offer.

We move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every step.

Sell2Rent is an equal opportunity employer.

Commissioning & Maintenance Specialist

Status: Non-exempt (hourly)

Location: Remote in the US

Position Summary

This position is responsible for commissioning, preventative maintenance troubleshooting, and repair of Plug power products including hydrogen storage infrastructure, electrolyzers, and stationary equipment at various customer sites. As such, this is a heavy travel position (up to 100%). This role requires excellent mechanical aptitude and a high degree of familiarity with industrial hydrogen systems and performance. This position also requires the ability to be on-call and to respond to urgent needs so that customer sites maintain hydrogen production around the clock. The ideal candidate should have the ability to communicate effectively among cross-functional departments with an emphasis on helping to improve electrolyzers system designs and resolve defects based upon field experience and data. This position is also critical to interface with customer stakeholders and exceed their expectations for service thereby furthering Plug Power's reputation as the leader in hydrogen fuel cell power solutions.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Travel as needed to customer sites to perform inspection, troubleshooting, repair, testing and commissioning of Plug power products including hydrogen storage infrastructure, electrolyzers, and stationary.
  • Execute and lead high level service repair projects on existing hydrogen infrastructure, including specialized service procedures including liquid tank repairs and vacuum jacket line repairs, etc.
  • Provide training to first responders, customers, and other Plug service personnel on troubleshooting, maintenance, and service of Hydrogen infrastructure.
  • Support the commissioning and ongoing maintenance and operation of industrial hydrogen infrastructure including but not limited to:
    • Interpreting electrical wiring schematics
    • Conducting Point to Point functionality testing
    • Pressure testing of piping systems per ASME standards
    • Testing and troubleshooting program issues with engineering assistance.
    • Inspecting of process piping systems (pressure ratings, fittings, etc.)
    • Provide documented results from system testing and commissioning at the completion of each project.
    • Create, track, and close out project task lists.
    • Knowledge of environmental impact on equipment function and performance
    • Ability to safely operate and control combustibles.
    • Ability to diagnose system problems and troubleshoot solutions.
    • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and P&IDs.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers and external vendors professionally and effectively.
  • Must be able to operate independently with minimal supervision while achieving high quality results in work assignments.
  • Must be able to adapt to changing requirements and meet project commitments/objectives without sacrificing workmanship or quality.
  • Shares ideas about process improvements and other cost saving measures with project team and management.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, and technical specifications.
  • Maintain a focus around safety in all facets of work and ensure that all relevant parties are educated on the safe operation of hydrogen equipment and infrastructure.
  • Represent Plug Power in a professional manner at all times and in all interactions.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned and required within role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Three (3) or more years of experience in construction, repair, or maintenance in an electrical, industrial, or mechanical field.
  • Associates degree or vocational degree in engineering, electronics, pressurized systems or other applicable field of study preferred. Or in lieu of a degree, 2 additional years of construction, repair, or maintenance experience in an electrical, industrial, or mechanical field.
  • Ability to travel as needed to carry out duties of the position – up to 100%

Desired Skills:

  • Industrial gas or high-pressure systems experience highly preferred
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of skill with mechanical systems installation, troubleshooting, and repair
  • Ability to diagnose system failures and isolate root cause
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office software for reporting and email correspondence

$27.50 - $40.00

raw.description:
Job Summary:

We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Product team.
You will be the connective tissue between business needs and product execution, translating stakeholder requirements into clear, actionable specifications that enable our Development, Design, and Quality Assurance teams to deliver valuable product outcomes.
Working closely with Product Managers, you will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to product delivery, freeing Product Managers to focus on strategy, discovery and product direction.
AI will be an important part of how you work. You will use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate high-volume activities such as drafting requirements, synthesizing feedback, identifying gaps, generating test scenarios, and preparing release documentation. You will direct the tools, critically evaluate their outputs, and remain fully accountable for everything shared with Development teams and stakeholders.
Make your impact with a rapidly growing marine software business.

Job Description:

You Will

  • Elicit, document, analyze, and validate business requirements through stakeholder interviews, working sessions, research, and product discovery activities.
    - Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate first-draft documentation while independently reviewing, refining, and validating all outputs.
    - Translate business and customer needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and measurable acceptance criteria.
    - Maintain a groomed backlog with PM partnership; use Claude for gap detection before tickets reach development.
    - Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, system behaviour, and product interactions to create alignment before development begins.
    - Act as trusted point of contact for scope, timelines, and delivery status; facilitate working sessions across business, product, and development.
    - Communicate changes, decisions, and rationale clearly - no one should be surprised.
    - Develop test scenarios for QA/UAT using Claude-generated drafts from acceptance criteria; track delivery against those criteria and escalate gaps.
    - Analyze product usage, support tickets, and stakeholder feedback to inform prioritization; build lightweight reporting for stakeholders and leadership.
    - Coordinate release notes using AI; partner with product marketing to enable internal teams before new capabilities ship.

You Bring

  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a similar role within a software or technology environment.
    - Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
    - Practical experience using Claude or comparable generative AI tools in a professional environment.
    - The ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated content, recognize inaccurate or incomplete outputs, and edit artifacts to a high professional standard.
    - Solid PDLC understanding; ability to read data via Excel, SQL, or BI platforms; comfortable in technical discussions without being a developer.
    - A solid understanding of how software products are built and how feature decisions connect to business outcomes (revenue, retention, operational efficiency).
    - Exceptional written and verbal communication - increasingly means editing AI-generated artifacts to a high standard.
    - Strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to align teams that may have different priorities or perspectives.
    - Experience working simultaneously across Product Management, Development, Design, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders.
    - The confidence to respectfully challenge stakeholder requests, uncover the underlying need, and determine whether the proposed solution is addressing the right problem.
    - A critical mindset and the ability to apply the same level of scrutiny to AI-generated outputs as you would to any other source of information.
    - The ability to work effectively through ambiguity while remaining organized, proactive, and focused on outcomes.

A CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or equivalent certification would be an asset. Demonstrated experience using Claude or other generative AI tools within a professional product or technology environment is valued alongside traditional qualifications.

Who You Are

You are goal-oriented, self-motivated, curious, and a clear communicator.

You take ownership of your work from initial conversation through delivery and validation. You approach ambiguity with curiosity and rigour, ask thoughtful questions, and are not afraid to challenge assumptions when doing so will lead to a better outcome.

You use AI confidently and responsibly - not as a replacement for judgment, but as a tool to work faster and more effectively. You know how to direct, assess, edit, and quality-check AI-generated content rather than treating the first output as finished work.

Most importantly, you care about helping teams build the right solutions, not simply documenting what you have been asked to build.

raw.description:
Role is open to candidates based in Africa only.

Amid increasing disruptions to global supply chains and shifts in the global aid financing landscape, the Senior Supply Chain Advisor (SSCA) will provide strategic leadership to help ensure reliable access to safe abortion commodities, contraceptives, and gender-based violence management supplies across development and humanitarian contexts. This role will strengthen supply availability through formal health systems and self-care pathways by establishing and enhancing global technical tools, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and partnerships that contribute to a sustainable abortion ecosystem. Effective supply chain management is a critical pillar for building resilient, responsive, and equitable pathways to care.

Summary of Responsibilities

The SSCA serve as subject matter expert for global health supply chain technical issues, in areas such as quantification, forecasting, procurement, storage and distribution and inventory management, logistics management information systems (LMIS), health systems strengthening, budgeting and financial management, driving and analyzing supply chain performance, and program effectiveness.

The role is expected to translate technical expertise into practical tools, country support, and partnership strategies that reduce supply interruptions and improve visibility, availability, and responsible use of reproductive health commodities.

Organizational Leadership and Strategy:

  • Lead the Ipas supply chain management approach across the network by ensuring that evidence and best practice inform strategies and efforts to sustain the availability of abortion and contraception drugs across the different pathways to care.

Program, technical, and functional responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership and support to strengthen sexual and reproductive health commodity supply chains at global, regional, and country levels across the pathways to care
  • Support countries to assess gaps in reproductive health commodity systems and implement corrective actions.
  • Improve forecasting, quantification, procurement, warehousing, distribution, transportation, quality assurance, and logistics management information systems for abortion and contraception commodities.
  • Design and optimize supply chain strategies, tools, and frameworks for SRH commodities in partnership with country programs, governments, and partners to speed up product flow.
  • Build national capacity through training, mentoring, curricula development, and knowledge transfer for supply chain staff and stakeholders.
  • Strengthen partnerships with national, regional, and international experts, institutions, and partner organizations to advance RH supply chain systems.
  • Promote evidence-based approaches, lessons learned, innovation, and increase data visibility and use for continuous improvement of supply chain performance and operations.
  • Establish quality assurance, sustainability assessment, monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and KPIs to track supply chain performance globally.
  • Mitigate supply chain disruptions through risk management, contingency planning, supplier diversification, and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Foster innovation in procurement, market shaping, inventory management, distribution, and technology-enabled global stock management, including in crisis-affected settings.
  • Contribute to the regional advocacy efforts to integrate abortion commodities in essential medicine lists (EML), including supporting the registration and marketing authorization of abortion commodities.
  • Capitalize on private sector supply chain capacity and knowledge for innovative packaging, distribution, and user experience documentation.
  • Lead monitoring and evidence synthesis on the safety and quality of abortion commodities used locally in order to contribute to external collective efforts of pharmacovigilance.

Resource mobilization:

  • Contribute to project design, proposal development, and opportunity prospecting for supply chain strengthening initiatives.
  • Participate in donor and partner calls to ensure supply chain needs, priorities, and progress are effectively represented across the Ipas network.
  • Assist procurement and contracting team with product quality assurance assessments and vendor certification vetting.
  • Coordinate and support financial review of global supply chain strengthening initiatives and projects

Communications & representation:

  • Lead efforts to highlight, advance, and advocate for abortion supply planning priorities by engaging supply chain coalitions and working groups, international NGOs, multilateral partners—including UN agencies, the World Bank Group, WHO—and donors to collaborate on and inform global abortion supply planning.
  • Contribute to evidence generation and knowledge sharing on reproductive health supply chains across countries, regional networks, technical forums, and international conferences.

Position Requirements

  • Deep commitment to sexual and reproductive health and rights, especially abortion and contraception access
  • Significant experience in key areas of supply chain system assessment approaches and tools, forecasting and quantification methods and tools, procurement processes, inventory control and distribution systems, and management information systems.
  • Experience working with private sector partners, including pharmacies, community distribution systems, and digital health platforms.
  • Professional-level fluency in English
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate teams and foster a positive work environment through supportive supervision, effective communication, shared leadership, and modeling of organizational core values.
  • Demonstrated capacity and commitment to sound stewardship of funds, including strong skills in work planning, budgeting, financial monitoring, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Proven ability to build positive working relationships with diverse internal teams and external partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and sound judgment skills, with the ability to identify and resolve policy and operational constraints.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent knowledge of and experience working with country and/or regional health system entities.

Education

Advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) in public health, supply chain management, logistics, health system strengthening, pharmacy, or related medical field

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in global health supply chain management, with a strong focus on reproductive health commodity supply chains.
  • Strong quantitative analysis and forecasting skills, cross-cultural diplomacy, and experience working in low-resource or humanitarian settings.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical assistance to global health programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health commodity supply chain management.
  • Knowledge of technical issues related to global health commodity procurement.
  • Demonstrated ability in strategic planning, program management, and implementation in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Experience working on sustainable commodity access programs.
  • Experience facilitating training and providing technical assistance to country teams, including through remote support

Working environment:

Ipas is a globally networked organization committed to shared leadership and local ownership. 67% of our leadership are women, and our teams are grounded in local expertise and lived experience. Equity is not an add-on — it drives how we design programs and how we work as an organization.
  • This position is fully remote, subject to change based on business need.
  • Flexibility to meet virtually in different time zones required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time internationally, including in crisis settings

Salary grade for this role is S2. Compensation for this position will be determined on the hiring country's prevailing market rate in addition to Ipas's own pay philosophy and other factors, such as the employee's experience level and expertise.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on WHO pre-qualification process with WHO-Listed Authorities, National Regulatory Authorities, and private sector.
  • Excellent knowledge of Logistics Management Information Systems, including e-LMIS, DHIS2, VAN, and Power BI.
  • Proficiency with at least one Ipas working language, such as French, Portuguese, or Spanish.

Ipas is strongly committed to providing a work environment that is free from all forms of harassment, discrimination, and inequity. We recruit, employ, train, promote, and compensate our personnel without regard to race, age, sex, religion, national origin, color, creed, ancestry, citizenship, caste, ethnicity, regional identity, tribal identity, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, gender identity, transgender status, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristic protected by law or outlined by Ipas policy. raw.description:
FlexTrade Systems:

FlexTrade Systems is a provider of customized multi-asset execution and order management trading solutions for buy- and sell-side financial institutions. Through deep client partnerships with some of the world's largest, most complex and demanding capital markets firms, we develop the flexible tools, technology and innovation that deliver our clients a competitive edge. Our globally distributed engineering teams focus on adaptable technology and open architecture to develop highly sophisticated trading solutions that can automate and scale with your business strategies.

At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to ever changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to ever interaction and we continue to improve, grow together and collaborate as one team. All of these while having Fun truly makes FlexTrade a wonderful place to work.

About You:

The Manager - Sales Strategy & Business Operations will report to the Global Lead, Sales Strategy & Business Operations. The individual will be a self-starter, with a hands-on consultative management style with proven structured approach to identify, initiate, manage & control multiple short to medium term business initiatives and projects

The individual will be responsible for working across functions and bring operational expertise to enable key global transformation initiatives. This role will be at the forefront in managing the change initiatives to accelerate growth, with a focus on key commercial functions – sales and client services

Requirements

Business Operations

  • Partner with multiple functional and line of business individuals globally including but not limited to: Sales, Client Services, Marketing, HR and Finance

  • Develop & improve analytics dashboards/report for key stakeholders

  • Reinforce and maintain key operational metrics, market intelligence and improvement programs.

  • Facilitate workshops/sprints for project management and tracking

  • Vendor management

  • Data management – Ensure Salesforce, LinkSquares and other tool data is up to date. Relevant reports and dashboards are readily available for management

AI/Copilot Implementation across Functions

  • Partner with multiple functional and line of business leaders globally to enhance / develop customized Copilot Agents in Microsoft Copilot, Claude Cowork, Salesforce (& potentially other solutions in future)

  • Help improve the AI adoption by working closely with key business/functional leads & teams

  • Ability to author / correct JSON for agent configuration using Copilot Studio

  • Work with 3rd parties to understand developing technologies & innovation in AI & contextualize/leverage that knowledge/skill within the organization

Sales Operations

  • Work closely with sales team members to monitor the performance metrics and initiatives to ensure sales organization success

  • Ensure new initiatives are being monitored and tracked diligently based on feedback from sales

  • Identify top market/competitor trends in terms of sales and operations best practices to ensure our project/initiatives portfolio is prioritizing the right initiatives

  • Identify opportunities for sales process improvement and foster an environment continuous improvement.

Client Service Operations

  • Work closely with Client Services to capture client/broker feedback, analyze, synthesize, and present key pain-points and improvement opportunities resulting in project pipeline and prioritization

  • Analyze the end-to-end client services experience to identify and prioritize key issues and opportunities

  • Prioritize implementation of automated solutions through Salesforce and help to prioritize roadmap initiatives based on business and client impact

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and foster an environment of continuous improvement.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Finance, Business Administration or other affiliated specialties like Engineering, MBA, or equivalent preferred

  • 7+ years in progressive functional business and/or operations roles with demonstrated experience in Technology Implementation/ Project Management and/or sales improvement /transformation

  • Management/technology/business transformation experience

  • Previous experience working in a financial service and/or technology company. Familiarity with Trading and Order/Execution Management Systems and/or subscription-based business models a plus

  • High proficiency in project management & analytical / data visualization tools such as advanced Excel & Power BI is a must

  • Strong understanding of Generative AI with hands-on experience in Context Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic Workflows.

  • Experience working with modern AI-assisted productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Claude CoWork. Basic knowledge and experience of structured data using JSON will be a strong advantage.

  • Proven experience working with public LLM APIs, such as OpenAI Response API and OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong knowledge of Model Context Protocol – Practical experience in building MCP servers using frameworks like FastMCP is a plus but not mandatory

  • Proficiency with or similar CRMs - Contract Lifecycle Management, Jira, Service Now etc is preferred

  • Ability to convey confidence, respect and trust, as well as maintain confidentiality of all company information

  • Strong ability to drive and manage global projects to completion, communicating a clear vision, while effectively managing different stakeholders

  • Strong conflict resolution and problem-solving abilities – Ability to develop partnerships with functional teams

***FlexTrade Systems, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by law.***

Company

Navitus

About Us

Navitus - Putting People First in Pharmacy - Navitus was founded as an alternative to traditional pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) models. We are committed to removing cost from the drug supply chain to make medications more affordable for the people who need them. At Navitus, our team members work in an environment that celebrates diversity, fosters creativity and encourages growth. We welcome new ideas and share a passion for excellent service to our customers and each other.. Current associates must use SSO login option at to be considered for internal opportunities. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees and comply with all applicable nondiscrimination regulations, including those related to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or handicap.

Pay Range

USD $90,593.00 - USD $111,157.00 /Yr.

STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)

5.00 - Salaried Non-Management except pharmacists

Work Schedule Description (e.g. M-F 8am to 5pm)

M-F 8am to 5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Navitus is unable to offer remote work to residents of Alaska, Hawaii, Maine, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Overview

Navitus Health Solutions is seeking a Account Executive to join our team!

National Accounts Management requires a highly strategic and consultative approach, focused on managing complex client needs, delivering customized solutions, and cultivating senior-level relationships across large organizations. This role demands the ability to operate with structure and discipline while also navigating ambiguity—balancing tailored strategy, cross-functional coordination, and long-term growth objectives.

Success in this role requires a strong commitment to standards, and maintaining consistency and rigor in execution. The ideal candidate demonstrates sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes as client relationships evolve. This role also includes travel to our corporate headquarters and client sites to support relationship management and business objectives.

The Account Executive (AE) is an individual contributor responsible for managing client relationships and supporting account strategy for employer, health plan, and PBM clients across a range of account sizes and complexity. This role serves as a primary point of contact for clients, broker consultants, and advisors, ensuring client needs are understood, addressed, and aligned with organizational capabilities. The Account Executive partners closely with Sales, Clinical Account Executives, Analytics, and Operations teams to support renewals, deliver strategic insights, and drive client satisfaction and retention.

The Account Executive role is a critical development position within company. It builds foundational skills in account ownership, strategic thinking, negotiation, and executive‑level communication while supporting the organization’s goals of delivering value‑driven, sustainable client solutions within the health benefits space.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Manage assigned client accounts across varying sizes and levels of complexity, maintaining strong working relationships with clients, brokers, and consultants.
  • Support account strategy development by gathering client needs, analyzing performance data, and contributing insights aligned to financial, clinical, and service objectives.
  • Lead renewal activities by coordinating internal inputs, preparing client materials, and supporting informed decision‑making through effective listening and needs assessment.
  • Build trusted relationships with client and consultant stakeholders through consistent engagement, professionalism, and responsiveness.
  • Identify opportunities for additional programs or solutions by evaluating client needs and vetting options in alignment with organizational standards and governance.
  • Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) by preparing materials, contributing to discussions, and supporting delivery of insights and recommendations.
  • Resolve client issues by coordinating with internal partners, applying appropriate judgment, and escalating matters when necessary.
  • Develop negotiation skills by balancing client expectations with company priorities and participating in discussions with senior client and consultant leaders.
  • Utilize company reporting systems, analytics tools, and platforms to support account management, performance monitoring, and client communications.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
  • 3 years of experience managing or supporting client accounts within PBM, health plan, healthcare, or related benefits environments required.
  • 3 years of experience working directly with clients, brokers, or consultants, including participation in renewal discussions and strategic meetings required.
  • 3 years of experience supporting or contributing to account planning, renewals, and performance discussions, including exposure to utilization, financial, or service data required.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining professional client relationships and supporting executive‑level interactions required.
  • Experience using reporting systems, analytics platforms, or company tools to support client decision‑making required.
  • Account Management experience is strongly preferred.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!
