Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) – 1099 Consultant
Location: Mostly Remote (Some CONUS & OCONUS Travel May Be Required)
Engagement Type: 1099 Independent Consultant — Project-Based / As Needed
Security Clearance: Active Top Secret Clearance Required
Position Overview
Conceras is seeking an experienced Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) to provide project-based consulting support for telecommunications infrastructure initiatives supporting U.S. Government facilities, including potential overseas diplomatic missions.
This is a 1099 independent consultant opportunity, with work assigned on a project-by-project and as-needed basis. The ideal consultant will bring a combination of telecommunications design expertise, field experience, and technical documentation capabilities and will be comfortable supporting both engineering/design efforts and field activities as project requirements dictate.
Travel within the continental United States (CONUS) and internationally (OCONUS) may be required depending on project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Design & Engineering
  • Develop telecommunications cabling system designs, including structured cabling systems (STCS) for copper, coaxial, and fiber-optic infrastructure.
  • Produce design documentation, CAD drawings, diagrams, and floor plans for telecommunications systems.
  • Prepare test plans, certified test reports, and installation documentation.
  • Develop scopes of work, bills of materials (BOMs), and technical proposal content.
  • Review construction documents and technical requirements to support system design and installation planning.
Field Operations & Surveys
  • Conduct on-site surveys and assessments to support telecommunications system design and installation planning.
  • Perform inspection and testing of cable plants, including:
    • Copper (Cat 3, 5e, 6, 6A, 7, and 8; UTP/STP)
    • Coaxial (RG-6/11, HDMI)
    • Optical fiber (single-mode and multimode)
  • Perform power testing, including UPS and standby systems, when required by the project.
  • Serve as a site manager, technical lead, or subject-matter expert when assigned.
  • Translate site conditions and survey findings into actionable design solutions and technical documentation.
Project Execution
  • Manage or support telecommunications infrastructure design and installation projects.
  • Coordinate testing, installation, inspection, and documentation activities.
  • Support task order development, RFIs, technical responses, and proposal inputs as needed.
  • Ensure work complies with applicable government standards, technical requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support project mobilization and execution within required timelines.
Collaboration & Reporting
  • Prepare and submit documentation related to meetings, site visits, surveys, testing, and project status.
  • Communicate effectively with Conceras team members, project partners, and government stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with engineering, project management, installation, and other technical personnel as required.
  • Provide timely and accurate technical input throughout assigned engagements.
Required Qualifications
  • Active BICSI RCDD certification.
  • Active Top Secret security clearance.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience within the past 7 years involving:
    • Telecommunications cabling design, testing, and installation.
    • Development of test plans and certified test reports.
    • Management or technical oversight of cable plant projects involving copper, coaxial, and fiber systems.
  • Demonstrated experience with:
    • Telecommunications and IT infrastructure design.
    • Technical proposal writing and documentation.
    • Scope of work development.
    • Bill of materials (BOM) development.
  • Ability to conduct site surveys and translate findings into practical design and installation solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of structured cabling standards, industry best practices, and applicable telecommunications requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a project-based consulting environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design software.
  • Experience supporting U.S. Government or Department of State projects.
  • Prior experience working in secure environments.
  • Experience supporting overseas facilities, including embassies and consulates.
  • Project management, site management, or technical leadership experience.
  • Familiarity with government telecommunications infrastructure and documentation requirements.
Security Requirements
  • Active Top Secret clearance is required.
  • Ability to maintain the required security clearance throughout the duration of assigned engagements.
  • Ability to comply with project-specific security and access requirements.
  • Familiarity with applicable government security standards and guidance, including:
    • National Industrial Security Program requirements.
    • Department of State security guidelines, including applicable Foreign Affairs Manual (FAM) requirements.
Work Environment & Travel
  • Work will be performed on a project-based and as-needed basis.
  • Assignments may include remote design/documentation support as well as work at government, contractor, or other project sites.
  • CONUS and/or OCONUS travel may be required depending on the specific assignment.
  • Work may be performed in secure or controlled-access environments.
Engagement Information
This opportunity is structured as a 1099 independent consultant engagement rather than a full-time employee position. The frequency, duration, location, and scope of assignments will vary based on project requirements and client needs.
Consultants should be adaptable and capable of supporting a range of responsibilities, from telecommunications engineering and design to site surveys, testing, technical documentation, and field leadership.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

Sezzle is currently seeking a Data Analyst to help drive business outcomes through analytics. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while partnering with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities, measure performance, and improve operational efficiency.

You will collaborate with teams across Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Support, Legal, and People Operations to define key metrics, build reporting solutions, and deliver actionable analysis. Responsibilities include writing SQL queries, developing dashboards, performing exploratory analyses, and contributing Python-based analytics workflows that support scalable decision-making across the business.

What You'll Do:

  • Work closely with business teams to understand their priorities and analytics needs
  • Create sophisticated analyses and reporting to provide insights at scale that support strategic initiatives and empower data-informed decision-making
  • Visualize and articulate analytics results to make it easy for stakeholders to interpret and take actions
  • Help stakeholders identify new opportunities through data analysis
  • Create, monitor, review, and analyze reports and dashboards, take initiative to fix issues that arise and conduct root cause analyses
  • Utilize modern AI tools, including LLMs, copilots, and workflow automation platforms, to enhance analytical productivity and develop scalable solutions to business problems

What We Look for:

  • Degree in statistics, math, actuarial science, economics, data science, computer science or related quantitative discipline
  • Master’s degree or 3+ years of professional experience working with data, which can include: complex dataset creation, reporting, profiling, and machine learning
  • Expert in using SQL to extract data and create actionable data sets
  • Experience with Python for data processing and analytics
  • Ability to complete analyses with minimal guidance
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Redash, Tableau, Looker or Power BI
  • Comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment, able to pivot quickly to new priorities
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills
  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline
  • Experience optimizing operational and financial performance
  • Experience in payments, financial services, banking, fintech, BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt)
  • AWS, G Suite, Mac
  • Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Verbal case study interview. Share how you approach new problems. A “How would you…” conversation.
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share your problem-solving experience. A “Tell me about a time when you…” conversation.
  • Offer!

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a Clinical Quality Specialist to help build out and strengthen the next phase of InStride Health's Clinical Quality and Patient Safety program as our patient census and organizational complexity continue to grow.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building systems, creating structure, and partnering across teams to improve the quality and safety of care. Reporting to the Director of Clinical Quality, this individual will play a key role in developing scalable quality programs, supporting patient safety operations, driving cross-functional initiatives, and helping establish the infrastructure needed to support a rapidly growing organization.

The Clinical Quality Specialist will partner closely with Clinical Services, Compliance, Operations, Product, and other stakeholders to implement quality initiatives, monitor clinical performance, oversee patient safety and complaints processes, support new program development, and leverage technology and AI to improve efficiency and scale. This is a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Director of Clinical Quality to build out new processes, workflows, and supporting documentation that strengthen and scale InStride's Clinical Quality Management Program.
  • Coordinate day-to-day patient safety operations, including intake, review, tracking, trend analysis, committee support, corrective action monitoring, and continuous improvement of the Patient Safety Event Reporting Program.
  • Support the oversight and continuous improvement of the complaints, grievance, and patient feedback processes, including intake, review, trend analysis, and identification of opportunities to improve the patient and family experience.
  • Support development of quality governance documents including annual work plans, program descriptions, program evaluations, committee charters, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Services to develop and maintain provider quality oversight activities including clinical documentation review processes, quality monitoring tools, performance indicators, and clinical trend reporting.
  • Partner with clinical leaders to support implementation and evaluation of new clinical programs and treatment models, including development of quality measures, implementation monitoring, and outcome evaluation.
  • Support external audits, health plan quality requirements, regulatory initiatives, and organizational readiness for future accreditation activities (e.g., URAC, NCQA).
  • Partner with Compliance to develop, review, and operationalize clinical policies, procedures, standards, and related quality documentation.
  • Analyze patient safety events, complaints, satisfaction data, documentation findings, and other quality indicators to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations for leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional quality and patient safety projects from concept through implementation, developing project plans, facilitating meetings, and driving multiple concurrent initiatives to completion while proactively identifying barriers and ensuring accountability for deliverables.
  • Prepare presentations, executive summaries, dashboards, and reports that translate quality data into meaningful operational insights for leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality workflows through technology, automation, artificial intelligence, and scalable operational processes.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across Clinical Services, Clinical Operations, Compliance, Product, Business Insights, and other operational teams to support organizational quality goals.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for clinical quality, patient safety, quality improvement methodologies, and regulatory best practices throughout the organization.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Clinical Quality, Patient Safety, Healthcare Quality Management, Accreditation, Clinical Operations, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Experience supporting quality management, patient safety, clinical oversight, quality improvement, or regulatory compliance activities.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level reports and presentations.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to translate data into meaningful recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across multiple departments without direct authority.
  • High level of initiative, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Highly preferred: Master’s degree in a behavioral health or healthcare-related field (e.g., Counseling, Psychology, Social Work, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Nursing, or similar).
  • Clinical licensure or previous clinical practice experience.
  • Experience building or expanding quality management or patient safety programs.
  • Experience supporting behavioral health organizations.
  • Experience conducting clinical documentation reviews or quality audits.
  • Experience with health plan audits, accreditation standards, or regulatory readiness.
  • Experience developing dashboards or quality reporting.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, or technology solutions to improve quality processes and operational efficiency.

The expected annual salary for this role is between $95,000-105,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, etc.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly () to verify its authenticity.

raw.excerpt: Por que a Valtech?  Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais.
raw.description:
Por que a Valtech?

Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreira internacional e a chance de definir o futuro das experiências. 

Aqui você encontrá um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto relevante e crescimento profissional.

Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho contribuirá para a transformação das indústrias.

Temos orgulho de: 

  •  O trabalho que realizamos e a inovação que promovemos
  •  Nossos valores: share, care e dare
  • Uma cultura que incentiva criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nosso modelo global sem fronteiras, que permite colaboração integrada e fluida

 

Estamos procurando alguém para se juntar à nossa equipe no escritório de Florianópois, São Paulo ou Remoto na função de Project Manager Sr

Missão da posição:

Gerenciar um projeto ou conjunto de projetos de agência — campanhas, conteúdo, mídia, social e produção — sendo responsável por entregar dentro do escopo acordado, no prazo e no orçamento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade das entregas criativas.

Liderar e mobilizar squads multidisciplinares (criação, mídia, social, produção e tecnologia), promovendo colaboração, agilidade e alta performance ao longo de todo o ciclo do projeto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerencia projetos e campanhas de acordo com a metodologia e os processos da agência (ágil, waterfall ou híbrido, conforme a necessidade do cliente e da entrega).
  • Define e mantém atualizado o cronograma do projeto, alinhando entregas de criação, mídia, social e produção.
  • Gerencia escopo e orçamento, e assegura a qualidade das entregas (peças, campanhas e conteúdos).
  • Monta e coordena squads multidisciplinares, alocando os profissionais certos (redação, design, mídia, social media, produção, dev) para cada entrega.
  • Identifica, monitora e mitiga riscos e problemas ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto/campanha.
  • É o principal ponto de contato com o cliente, gerenciando expectativas e o relacionamento no dia a dia.
  • Reporta status interna e externamente, com dashboards e indicadores de performance do projeto/campanha.
  • Controla custos, horas e verbas — incluindo investimento em mídia, quando aplicável — versus orçamento aprovado.
  • Gerencia alocação de recursos, horas e capacidade do time entre múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Promove sinergia entre contas, projetos e squads, evitando trabalho em silo.
  • Avalia a performance de projetos e campanhas e propõe ações de melhoria.
  • Avalia a performance dos membros do time e propõe ações de desenvolvimento.
  • Comunica-se de forma clara e direta com o time e os stakeholders, inclusive sobre o que não foi dito.
  • Cria e incentiva um ambiente de comunicação contínua, colaboração e compartilhamento de conhecimento ("trabalhar em voz alta").
  • Demonstra responsabilidade e accountability por tudo o que acontece em seu(s) projeto(s).

Requisitos:

Inglês Upper Intermediate/ Avançado.

+5 anos de experiência como Project Manager em agências de publicidade, marketing, criação ou comunicação (não é pré-requisito vir de empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria).

Vivência gerenciando múltiplos projetos e/ou contas simultaneamente, com times de criação, mídia, social e produção.

Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos usadas em agência (ex.: Monday.com, Asana, Trello, Jira ou similares).

Conhecimento de fluxos de aprovação de peças, processos de produção e gestão de verba/investimento em mídia (desejável).

Familiaridade com métricas e KPIs de campanha (alcance, engajamento, performance) e capacidade de montar relatórios e dashboards simples.

Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação, Marketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Diferenciais:

Vivência com metodologias ágeis

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.
Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.
Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.
Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner. 

Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Quer fazer parte do próximo capítulo? Venha fazer parte do time!

raw.title: Chief of Staff - Commercial Strategy
raw.excerpt: Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all.
raw.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .

Arcadia is at a growth stage where the connective tissue between ideation, execution, and executive decision-making matters enormously. This primarily manifests across two areas today: (1) Growth (Strategy, Sales, and Retention & Expansion) and (2) cross-functional Executive initiatives. This role sits at that intersection: you will partner with the Chief Commercial Officer to identify and launch new growth initiatives—whether that's a new vertical, a new go-to-market partnership, or a new solution while also engaging directly with the executive team to drive alignment on the initiatives that matter most across the company. In practice, this typically plays out as roughly 75% of your time on commercial strategy and growth initiatives, and roughly 25% partnering directly with the executive team and supporting the Chief Executive Officer.

This is a role of ownership and initiative, not execution-on-request. You will be given real latitude to define how new opportunities get approached, how cross-functional work gets organized, and how the executive team stays aligned—and you'll be trusted to run with it. You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and partner closely with Product, Clinical, Value Enablement, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Actuary, Account Management, and the broader executive team.

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia helps healthcare and life sciences organizations deliver measurable results. We unify fragmented data across the healthcare ecosystem so payers, providers, ACOs, and life sciences companies can make confident decisions grounded in trustworthy intelligence. Our platform supports more than 200 organizations and 40 million attributed lives across value-based care, risk adjustment, population health, and life sciences programs.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you have mapped the highest-priority growth opportunities in front of Arcadia, built relationships across Product, Clinical, Value Enablement, Marketing, and the executive team, and built the business case for at least one priority initiative.

In year one, you have taken two or more growth initiatives from concept to real traction—whether new verticals, partnerships, or products—contributed measurably to pipeline generation and competitive win rates, and become a trusted driver of alignment within the executive committee and board cadence.

What You'll Be Doing

    Launch New Growth Initiatives

    You will partner across the Commercial, Value Enablement, and Product teams to identify and pursue new paths to growth—whether that's a new vertical, a strategic partnership, a new product or solution go-to-market motion, or another initiative altogether—taking ownership of the work from initial concept through initial traction.

  • Identify and size new growth opportunities by understanding the market, our competitive position, and where Arcadia's assets and talent can be leveraged to win
  • Build the business case for each opportunity: market sizing, financial rationale, resourcing needs, and risks, so leadership can make a clear go or no-go decision
  • Partner with Thought Leadership, Value Enablement, Product, Clinical, Partnerships, and other domain SMEs as needed to shape the specifics of each initiative—what it is, who it's for, and how it comes together
  • Build the GTM positioning and competitive differentiation for each initiative, grounded in Arcadia's outcomes-first brand and validated against real buyer needs
  • Translate the business case into a tactical execution plan, and drive that plan forward: coordinate cross-functional workstreams, resolve dependencies, and keep the initiative moving toward real traction
  • Define success criteria for each initiative and track progress against commitments

    • Strengthen GTM Motion

    New markets don't succeed in isolation—they depend on a commercial engine that's tightly coordinated. You will take initiative to close gaps and accelerate growth across the teams that make GTM work and bring visibility into that progress at the executive level.

  • Build and refresh competitive intelligence in target markets, synthesizing signals from win/loss data, market research, analyst commentary, and field input
  • Collaborate with Value Enablement and Solutions Consulting to improve discovery-to-proposal velocity, solution credibility, and RFP quality
  • Partner with Actuary to sharpen financial modeling, risk quantification, and ROI frameworks used in payer and risk-bearing organization deals
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment meetings, manage project tracking for strategic commercial initiatives, and proactively remove blockers
  • Bring commercial progress, risks, and decisions needing executive input directly into board and executive committee conversations

    • Executive Team Support

    As Arcadia scales, the initiatives that matter most increasingly cut across teams and leaders—commercial expansion chief among them. This role gives you a direct seat in that conversation, extending the alignment work you do in Commercial to the executive team as a whole.

  • Drive the Executive Committee Operating Rhythm: Help shape and run the weekly executive committee meeting -- build agendas, synthesize pre-reads, capture decisions, and drive follow-through across leaders
  • Partner on board meeting preparation, ensuring materials reflect a coherent narrative across commercial, product, and financial priorities
  • Take ownership of cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple teams and executives, acting as the driver who keeps them moving and accountable
  • Proactively surface where executive-level initiatives are stalling and broker resolution before they become bigger problems
  • Take on special projects with the executive team as they arise, applying the same ownership and rigor used in the commercial work

What You'll Bring

    Required

  • Seven or more years in healthcare GTM strategy, strategy consulting, or a commercial leadership role
  • Deep fluency in the payer or provider landscape—you can speak credibly to value-based care, population health, risk adjustment, quality and Stars
  • Demonstrated experience taking a growth idea from concept to traction in a B2B healthcare context—building the business case, shaping the go-to-market approach, and driving execution
  • Experience partnering with executives or a board on operating rhythms, including meeting preparation, cross-functional tracking, and driving follow-through on strategic commitments
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who can align product, clinical, finance, sales, and executive stakeholders behind a common strategy
  • Comfort working in ambiguity—this role requires structuring undefined problems and building the plan, not executing a defined playbook
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build crisp, compelling narratives for executive, board, and buyer audiences

    • Preferred

  • Experience with data and analytics platforms sold to payers, ACOs, or risk-bearing organizations
  • Familiarity with buyer segments beyond traditional payer and provider markets—including self-funded employers, risk-bearing entities, or adjacent healthcare services organizations
  • Prior experience as a chief of staff, or in a strategy-and-operations role partnering closely with a CEO or executive committee

What You'll Get

  • Competitive compensation and strong benefits
  • Employee-driven programs and initiatives for personal and professional development
  • Membership in the talented, energized, diverse, and purpose-driven Arcadian Community
  • Be a part of a mission driven company that is transforming the healthcare industry by changing the way patients receive care

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

Protect Yourself

If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.
This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

Lead Java Full Stack Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Lead Java Full Stack Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $80,000–$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an accomplished Lead Java Full Stack Engineer to architect, design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems that operate at significant scale and across multiple business domains. In this role you will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from translating business requirements into robust technical designs, to writing production-quality code, to deploying cloud-native services and supporting them through their full operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep backend expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, component-driven front-end applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. You will work closely with product managers, architects, DevOps engineers, and fellow developers in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality, secure, and performant applications that directly support strategic business outcomes.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience building production-grade enterprise applications.
  • Strong, demonstrable understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and end-to-end system design principles.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Java (versions 11 and 17), the Spring Boot framework, and the design of clean, idiomatic RESTful APIs.
  • Hands-on, production-level experience designing and operating microservices architectures, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, and observability patterns.
  • Proven experience developing front-end applications using React, with working familiarity in Angular or Vue considered a strong plus.
  • Strong SQL skills and meaningful experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server, including query tuning and schema design.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tooling and Git-based version control workflows, including branching strategies, code review practices, and release management.
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications to at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including familiarity with managed services, networking, and identity primitives.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills, with the discipline to investigate problems methodically and document findings clearly.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing and operating event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Exposure to distributed system design principles such as eventual consistency, CAP trade-offs, idempotency, and saga patterns.
  • Experience writing automation tests using modern frameworks and contributing to test-driven and behavior-driven development practices.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to . Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

raw.description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

Canopy, Draper, UT- Remote

About Us

Canopy is a fast-growing SaaS company in Draper, Utah building simple, efficient software for accounting firms. We are looking to revolutionize the accounting space with modern, user-friendly software for a neglected industry.

We aim to help our clients unlock the firm they’ve always wanted with our Practice Management Suite. We place a strong emphasis on delighting our customers, spotting and solving problems, and being good people along the way. And we just secured $70M in Series C funding to help us fulfill that mission.

Click here to see why our clients (and investors) love Canopy.

Interested in learning more about Canopy & the industry? Check out our blog here where you can find great information on our product features, industry news, practice management, and more!

The Opportunity

Canopy is a fast-growing SaaS startup in Draper, Utah building simple, efficient software for accounting firms. We are looking to revolutionize the accounting space with modern, user-friendly software for a neglected industry. We place strong emphasis on delighting our customers, spotting and solving problems, and being good people along the way.

We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help make our world-class practice management platform for accounting professionals even better. You'll work on a highly collaborative squad alongside other engineers, a product manager, UX designer, and QA engineer, with the autonomy to research, hypothesize, build, test, and iterate on the best solutions for our customers. Our microservices backend and micro-frontend architecture support independent deployments, letting our teams ship to production multiple times a day. If you want to have a meaningful impact at a company that means "agile" when we say it, we'd love to hear from you.

This role is remote eligible for candidates who currently reside in Utah.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with your PM, UX designer, fellow engineers, QA, and customers to define and validate new features end-to-end
  • Build user-facing experiences in JavaScript/TypeScript and React that delight our customers
  • Design and implement REST API endpoints and microservices using Python with FastAPI or Java with Vert.x, backed by PostgreSQL
  • Write unit tests, participate in code reviews, and help maintain quality across the codebase
  • Own builds and deployments to staging and production using Docker, GitLab, and Kubernetes
  • Identify, prioritize, and resolve bugs and technical debt across the stack
  • Share what you learn through mentoring, trainings, and interviewing future teammates
  • Contribute to effective AI driven engineering tooling that improves quality and efficiency for every engineer

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with meaningful exposure to both frontend and backend work (we don't expect equal depth in both)
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, with experience in React or a similar modern framework
  • Strong proficiency in at least one of the following backend languages (Python, Java, or Kotlin) and comfort with SQL and RESTful API design
  • Familiarity with modern tooling: TypeScript, Git, and testing frameworks for both front end and back end code
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor, an eagerness to adopt the latest advancements and best practices, and the judgment to steer AI toward high-quality code you fully understand and can stand behind
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with both technical and non-technical teammates
  • A passion for building scalable solutions that have real customer impact

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Proficiency with microservices architecture or micro-frontend infrastructure
  • Experience with observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing)
  • Hands-on experience building features that integrate LLMs or AI capabilities into a product

We know many women do not apply for a job if they don't perfectly fit the description. We want you to apply anyway.

Why You Want to Work Here

🌴 Flexible Paid Time Off - you’re actually encouraged to use, plus 10 company holidays!

title: Marketing Operations Manager

raw.title: Marketing Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets.
raw.description:
Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets. We combine deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure to unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

As we scale, we are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and manage the infrastructure that connects our marketing activity with sales. This is a hands-on role focused on making HubSpot a powerful operating system for understanding contact engagement, identifying intent signals, delivering relevant nurture, and helping our sales team engage the right people at the right time.

This is not an inbound lead-generation or MQL-focused role. The objective is to understand how contacts are engaging with Tangible over time — what they are reading, which campaigns they respond to, what they do on our website, and other relevant signals — so that we can identify increasing levels of interest and act quickly.

You will own the day-to-day marketing operations architecture in HubSpot, while also managing nurture campaigns, marketing messaging and the operational side of content. You will work closely with leadership and Sales to ensure our marketing activity generates useful signals and actionable intelligence, rather than simply producing more leads.

Tasks

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

  • Own and manage Tangible's HubSpot marketing operations architecture.
  • Build, maintain and optimise HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Ensure HubSpot is correctly structured to capture and connect engagement data across marketing channels.
  • Develop robust processes for tracking contact engagement across email, website activity, content consumption, campaigns and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
  • Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Engagement Scoring & Intent Signals

  • Build and continuously refine contact engagement scoring based on meaningful behavioural signals.
  • Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
  • Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
  • Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner.
  • Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
  • Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
  • Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Nurture & Marketing Automation

  • Design, build and manage nurture programmes in HubSpot.
  • Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
  • Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
  • Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Messaging & Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Sales to understand the messaging and information they need to engage prospects effectively.
  • Develop and manage marketing messaging for nurture campaigns, email campaigns and other targeted communications.
  • Support Sales with relevant outreach messaging, follow-ups, campaign assets and other enablement materials.
  • Use engagement data and audience behaviour to inform messaging and help Sales personalise outreach.
  • Help Sales understand how to interpret and act on engagement signals coming from HubSpot.
  • Identify content and messaging that can support specific sales conversations and commercial priorities.

Content Operations
Content is not the primary responsibility of this role. Instead, you will ensure that Tangible's content is properly integrated into our marketing operations infrastructure.

  • Ensure content assets, reports, newsletters and other marketing activity are properly connected to HubSpot.
  • Make sure content engagement can be tracked at the contact level and incorporated into relevant segmentation and scoring.
  • Work with the wider team to ensure campaigns and content launches are set up correctly from an operational perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to use existing content within nurture programmes and sales journeys.
  • Report on which content is generating meaningful engagement and signals of interest.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Build clear reporting around contact engagement, campaign performance, nurture activity and sales signals.
  • Provide leadership and Sales with actionable insight rather than vanity metrics.
  • Identify patterns in contact behaviour and engagement that can inform marketing and sales activity.
  • Measure the effectiveness of nurture programmes, scoring models and marketing campaigns.
  • Continuously improve the marketing operations infrastructure based on data, feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and Sales to align marketing operations with commercial priorities.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure engagement signals are genuinely useful in day-to-day prospecting and relationship management.
  • Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
  • Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years' experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related B2B marketing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing HubSpot architecture. This is a must-have.
  • Demonstrable experience building and managing HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Experience designing and managing engagement or behavioural scoring models.
  • A strong understanding of how behavioural signals can be used to prioritise contacts and improve Sales engagement.
  • Experience building and optimising nurture campaigns and automated customer/prospect journeys.
  • Comfortable working across Marketing and Sales and translating commercial requirements into practical marketing-operations solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contact data, segmentation, lifecycle management and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to analyse engagement data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong copywriting and messaging skills, particularly for B2B audiences and nurture campaigns.
  • Commercially minded, with an understanding that marketing operations should ultimately help Sales have better conversations with the right people.
  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable owning the function independently and building processes from the ground up.
  • Experience in private markets, PE/VC, financial services or another complex B2B environment is preferred.

What You'll Own

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You will be responsible for making sure Tangible's marketing infrastructure works properly — from the underlying HubSpot architecture through to scoring, segmentation, nurture and the signals delivered to Sales.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys building systems, understanding how people behave, and turning data into action. You should be equally comfortable getting deep into a HubSpot workflow and working with Sales on how a particular engagement signal should change their approach.

You will have the opportunity to build the marketing operations function as Tangible scales, with significant ownership over the systems, processes and programmes that connect marketing activity to revenue.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve accuracy, efficiency, or process automation (payroll or adjacent workflows)

AI-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done across our organization — from payroll validation to workflow automation — and that will continue to grow. We’re looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and interested in using technology to improve how work gets done.

raw.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Machine Learning engineer!

As part of Beacon's analytics and machine learning domain, you'll work alongside fellow data scientists, neuroscientists, engineers, and clinicians to scope, build, deploy, and maintain the machine and deep learning models that analyze brain and biosignal data for advancing sleep, neurological, and psychiatric therapy development.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those who lead by example. As such, we're always seeking out new contributors whose work demonstrates innate curiosity, a bias toward simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and—most of all—a deep empathy toward colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs in Boston, New York City and Paris.

What success looks like

  • Participate in and lead the entire biosignal-based algorithm development lifecycle for medical devices including specifications and requirements gathering, data curation and labeling, development, failure-analysis, production, maintenance, and documentation.
  • Select, implement, and develop the most appropriate method for each problem, knowing when to apply deep learning techniques and when other methods are more effective.
  • Enhance our internal deep learning and machine learning tools to boost team efficiency, introduce new model architectures and algorithmic techniques, and refine the codebase to encourage reusability where needed to enable rapid experimentation.
  • Spread and improve our best practices to ensure algorithm implementations are user-friendly, well-documented, and thoroughly tested, including unit tests, comprehensive documentation, CI, and non-regression testing.
  • Present results to key stakeholders and assist them in utilizing algorithms for client engagement.
  • Support the client-facing projects to understand and shape the impact Beacon algorithms have for our customers, both for existing deployed algorithms, and future algorithm development.

What you will bring

  • You have more than 4 years of industry experience in machine learning and deep learning, particularly in health sciences or other regulated fields, with a proven track record of bringing algorithms into production.
  • You are experienced with digital signal processing (DSP) and statistics and care about using the right tool for the job, which in many cases might not be machine learning or deep learning.
  • You are proficient in using PyTorch (preferred) or other deep learning frameworks for training, developing, and deploying deep learning models.
  • You are familiar with latest Deep Learning advances (Transformer/ViT, large scale modeling, large model training, ...)
  • You follow and adopt best practices in software and ML engineering, including testing, version control, code reviews, documentation, Dockerization, CI/CD, and experiment tracking.
  • You are familiar with biosignals, medical imaging data, or large time-series datasets, or are enthusiastic about learning more in the domain.
  • You thrive in a team environment, recognizing that collaboration, open communication, and continuous feedback are essential for collective success.
  • You are able to distill, discuss, and present complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for the audience at hand, both internally and externally.
  • You are excited to participate in the entire algorithm development lifecycle, which spans scoping, data wrangling, algorithm development/experimentation, formal validation, quality/regulatory documentation, production deployment, and working with clients who might benefit from these algorithms.

The base salary range for this role is determined based on past experience, specific skills and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Do you thrive on solving tough problems—even under pressure? Are you motivated by fast-paced environments with continuous learning opportunities? Do you enjoy collaborating with a team of peers who push you to constantly up your game?

At Pythian, we are building a next-generation Site Reliability Engineering team. We need motivated and talented individuals on our teams, and we want you!

raw.description:
SAP Data Conversion Consultant- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Data Conversion Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Conversion Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.

How to Apply

Calyxo, Inc. is a medical device company headquartered in Pleasanton, California, USA. The company was founded in 2016 to address the profound need for improved kidney stone treatment. Our team is led by executives and investors with a proven track record of commercializing paradigm-shifting devices to meet unmet needs within urology.

Are you ready to change the future of kidney stone treatment? We are seeking high achievers who want to be part of a dynamic team working in a fun, diverse atmosphere.

Summary:

The Clinical Specialist is a focused individual who has a passion for patient care and physician and staff education. This person will proctor cases to excellence and independently cover CVAC procedures, training the surgical team on the safe and effective uses of the device. The Clinical Specialist works closely with the surgical team members to provide clinical product assistance to the surgeon by being familiar with the surgical procedure, instruments, supplies, and equipment.

The Clinical Specialist will train the surgical team on instrument preparation prior to cases and during the surgical procedure. This role will manage inventory needs in the account and any accompanying administrative requirements.

This role is not considered for pathway to a Territory Sales Manager at Calyxo Inc, due to the tenure and experience required to execute the Territory Sales Manager role.

Ideal candidates will live in the targeted geographical area.

raw.description:
Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas a desafios técnicos, que se identifiquem com um ambiente dinâmico e diverso, e que combinem profundidade técnica com visão de negócio para atuar como referência especializada na operação de segurança de uma instituição financeira S2.

A posição atua como referência técnica (trilha de especialista) na Gerência de Operações de Segurança (SecOps), liderando tecnicamente projetos complexos, definindo padrões, arquiteturas e estratégias de proteção cibernética e orientando as equipes na adoção das melhores práticas de mercado. Atua integrada à 1ª linha de defesa e em articulação com a Arquitetura/CoE de Segurança e a 2ª linha (CISO), com escopo em Arquitetura de Segurança, definição de padrões, projetos estratégicos, avaliação de riscos complexos, consultoria técnica especializada e evolução tecnológica.

Terá foco na engenharia de segurança, que visa absorver de forma estruturada os handovers de projetos e a evolução tecnológica vinda da 2ª linha e da Arquitetura, evitando que a engenharia concorra com a demanda operacional do dia a dia.

O desafio central é elevar a régua técnica de segurança e sustentar a evolução para uma defesa proativa e risk-based, orientada a frameworks de mercado (NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Benchmarks e MITRE ATT&CK), sob os requisitos do BACEN, da Resolução CMN nº 5.274 e da LGPD. A posição tem, ainda, potencial de assumir a Coordenação quando a equipe for ampliada.

Referência técnica e evolução tecnológica

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de segurança, definindo arquiteturas e padrões corporativos de proteção cibernética;
  • Avaliar riscos tecnológicos associados a novas iniciativas e atuar como consultor interno para temas complexos;
  • Promover a inovação e a adoção de novas tecnologias de proteção, elaborando estratégias de evolução tecnológica e de maturidade;
  • Influenciar decisões corporativas relacionadas à segurança, sustentando baselines, hardening (CIS Benchmarks) e a remediação estrutural de vulnerabilidades comprovadas em testes de Red/White Team;
  • Orientar tecnicamente analistas e coordenadores em temas especializados (ex.: IAM/PAM, cloud security, proteção de dados, detecção e resposta, AI Security);
  • Representar a organização junto a fornecedores, auditorias e fóruns técnicos especializados.

Conformidade, riscos e sustentação

  • Assegurar aderência aos padrões, políticas e requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis (Resolução CMN nº 5.274, BACEN e LGPD);
  • Apoiar a análise de causa raiz de incidentes relevantes e a definição de soluções para problemas de alta complexidade;
  • Contribuir para a produção de evidências técnicas e para a resolução de apontamentos de auditoria interna, externa e reguladores.
  • Formação superior em Cibersegurança, Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência técnica em Segurança da Informação e Segurança Cibernética, atuando como referência especialista em um ou mais domínios de SecOps;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte; experiência no sistema financeiro é diferencial relevante;

raw.description:
Ideal start timeline: September 2026

Role status: Exempt

Compensation: Our target hiring range is $105,000-$140,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $7,000 bonus. Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

Campminder’s Flexible Working Location: Our employees have the option to work 100% remotely within the United States or their choice of days at home and at our office in Boulder, Colorado. We host a variety of all-company hybrid meetings and social events. We require anybody working remotely to have a very reliable, high-speed internet connection.

We know the best people can choose to work anywhere.

Here’s a few reasons why 100+ of them choose Campminder:

  • With 20+ years experience of serving the industry through its digital transformation, we’re stable, profitable, and have developed a loyal customer base (that continues to grow).
  • We build software for summer camps, an industry that enables meaningful experiences for kids.
  • We work on interesting, ambitious projects that create real value for our clients.
  • We know our team members feel their work has an impact on the organization’s purpose.
  • At the same time, we are genuinely committed to work/life balance. Our team members feel they have the flexibility to take time off when needed and feel supported in making use of flexible working arrangements.
  • We invest in emerging technology and cutting-edge leadership and are proud to take an "AI-Enabled" approach in our solutions.
  • We’ve been listed on Outside Magazine’s 50 Best Places to Work for 8 consecutive years for our values-led culture and employee experience.

This role’s mission & overview:

Camp directors judge us by how confidently and independently they can run their operations in our platform, from initial launch through every season that follows. This role owns that experience through two equally important pillars: Implementation and Learning. You'll set the strategic direction and roadmap for both, keeping our white-glove onboarding sharp for our most complex accounts while building the content, curriculum, and systems that let smaller camps get up and running largely on their own. As we modernize our platform, the roadmap you set here becomes the foundation for how every camp learns our system, for years to come.

As a Manager of Learning & Implementation, you will:

  • Own the strategic direction and roadmap for both Implementation and Learning, deciding what gets built, in what order, and why, grounded in data rather than instinct.
  • Manage and develop your team of implementation specialists and learning content specialists, setting clear priorities and standards and holding people accountable to them.
  • Direct execution of Implementation, guiding your team's priorities and standards for how camps move through technical setup and onboarding.
  • Direct execution of Learning, guiding your team's priorities for the curriculum, self-serve content, and knowledge base infrastructure that let classic and small camps launch with far less hands-on support.
  • Design learning programs and implementation processes built to flex, not just scale, so they hold up as the UI evolves and new technologies (including AI-driven tools) reshape how camps interact with the platform.
  • Partner across Support, Success, Sales, and Product — working especially closely with Product to keep Learning ahead of platform changes, so new features and modernization efforts launch with the training and content camps need already in place, not built after the fact.
  • Define and report on the metrics that prove both pillars are working, from launch quality and time-to-value to support case deflection, and adjust the roadmap based on what the data shows.

We think a successful candidate will bring:

  • You've managed people, including motivating a team, holding people accountable to clear expectations, and managing a budget responsibly.
  • You've set strategy for an area of a business, translating goals into priorities, tradeoffs, and a clear plan for how the work should move forward.
  • You have experience with Learning and Implementation roles in SaaS businesses, and are familiar with best practices in those disciplines, including how AI is changing customer onboarding, enablement, and learning.
  • You've used real data to set priorities, make tradeoffs, and explain why one path should come before another, even if you have not owned the full roadmap for a function before.
  • You know how to define what success should look like, track whether the work is having the intended impact, and adjust your approach when the data says something is not working.
  • You've represented your work in a high-stakes conversation, whether that's with a senior leader, a frustrated customer, or a cross-functional group with competing priorities.

Our Interview Process:

  1. 45 min - interview with People & Culture
  2. 60 min - interview with Hiring Manager
  3. Phase 3:
    1. 60 min - interview with a Client Services Leader
    2. 60 min - interview with Head of Product Insights

  • Ability to choose where you work - remotely, in the office, or a mix!

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply:

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you!

We encourage applications from parents, parents-to-be, and those responsible for the caretaking of others.
